property_summary: For any caller and any amount, a withdrawBalance whose external payout is refused must revert (restoring nothing visible as success); the mutant swallows the failed call and reports success while silently destroying the balance, so it returns ok=true where the reference always returns ok=false.
change_summary: Remove the revert-on-failed-call check so that when the send fails, userBalance[msg.sender] stays zeroed whereas P would have reverted and restored the balance.
